```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(xml2)
library(broom)
library(forestploter)

save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```

# Review data dictionary.
```{r}
get_data_dictionary = function(path_to_xml) {
  data_dictionary = read_xml(path_to_xml)
  nodes = xml_find_all(data_dictionary, "//description")
  df = data.frame(
    name = xml_text(xml_find_all(nodes, "//name")),
    description = xml_text(xml_find_all(nodes, "//description"))[-1]
  )
}
```

```{r}
epc_with_nwd = left_join(epc, mapping_table)
```

# If there are duplicates, I need to remove them. There are a few.
```{r}
check_epc_subject_dups = epc_with_nwd %>%
  group_by(shareid) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

check_mapping_subject_dups = mapping_table %>%
  group_by(shareid) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

subjects_to_drop = check_mapping_subject_dups %>%
  filter(count > 1) %>%
  pull(shareid)
```

# Join with CHIP and remove duplicate samples.
```{r}
epc_with_chip = left_join(epc_with_nwd, topmed_chip_calls) %>%
  filter(!is.na(haschip)) %>%
  filter(!(shareid %in% subjects_to_drop)) %>%
  left_join(topmed_variant_calls)

table(epc_with_chip$haschip)
table(epc_with_chip$mutated_genes)
```

# Add covariates
```{r}
# From metadata files:

# from diab:
# current diabetes status, exam 8
diab_select = diab %>%
  dplyr::select(dbGaP_Subject_ID, shareid, CURR_DIAB8) %>%
  dplyr::rename(diabetes_status = "CURR_DIAB8")

# from exams:
# hypertension medication
# weight, height -> convert to BMI (weight / height^2)
exams_select = exams %>%
  dplyr::select(dbGaP_Subject_ID, shareid, H014, H111, H233, H393, H399) %>%
  dplyr::rename(hypertension_medication = "H014", weight = "H393", height = "H399") %>%
  mutate(BMI = (703 * weight) / (height^2))

# from smoke:
# cigarette smoking status, exam 8
smoke_select = smoke %>%
  dplyr::select(dbGaP_Subject_ID, shareid, STATUS8) %>%
  dplyr::rename(smoke_status = "STATUS8")

# from dates:
# sex
# age
dates_select = dates %>%
  dplyr::select(dbGaP_Subject_ID, shareid, age8, sex)

# from fhslab1:
# total cholesterol
# hdl cholesterol
# triglycerides
fhslab1_select = fhslab1 %>%
  dplyr::select(dbGaP_Subject_ID, shareid, TOT_CHOL, HDL_CHOL, TRIG) %>%
  mutate(cholesterol_ratio = HDL_CHOL / TOT_CHOL) %>%
  mutate(log_trig = log(TRIG))


# List of dataframes
covariates_list = list(diab_select, exams_select, smoke_select, dates_select, fhslab1_select)

# Full join on all dataframes
combined_covariates = purrr::reduce(covariates_list, full_join, by = c("dbGaP_Subject_ID", "shareid"))

# From CHIP calls:
# AgeAtBloodDraw
# sex
epc_with_covariates = epc_with_chip %>%
  left_join(combined_covariates, by = c("dbGaP_Subject_ID", "shareid"))

# There are a few cases where age does not match between CHIP call and covariates. Dropping those samples.
epc_with_covariates = epc_with_covariates %>%
  mutate(FlooredAgeAtBloodDraw = floor(AgeAtBloodDraw)) %>%
  filter(age8 == FlooredAgeAtBloodDraw) %>%
  dplyr::select(-FlooredAgeAtBloodDraw)

table(epc_with_covariates$haschip)
table(epc_with_covariates$Gene)
table(epc_with_covariates$mutated_genes)
```

# Prep variables for analysis.
```{r}
epc_with_covariates$VAF[is.na(epc_with_covariates$VAF)] = 0
epc_with_covariates$High_VAF = ifelse(epc_with_covariates$VAF > 0.1, 1, 0)

epc_with_covariates$rink_cd31  = qnorm((rank(epc_with_covariates$CD31, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(epc_with_covariates$CD31)))
epc_with_covariates$rink_cd34  = qnorm((rank(epc_with_covariates$CD34, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(epc_with_covariates$CD34)))
epc_with_covariates$rink_KDR133  = qnorm((rank(epc_with_covariates$KDR133, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(epc_with_covariates$KDR133)))
epc_with_covariates$rink_cd31pos  = qnorm((rank(epc_with_covariates$CD31pos, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(epc_with_covariates$CD31pos)))

```

```{r}
prepare_tidy_models = function(model_list, model_name_list) {
  tidy_models = lapply(model_list, tidy)
  names(tidy_models) = model_name_list

  tidy_models = lapply(tidy_models, function(df) {
    df %>% filter(term == "haschip")
  })
  
  tidy_models = do.call(rbind, tidy_models) %>%
    rownames_to_column("model")
  
  return(tidy_models)
}

generate_forest_plot = function(results_df, 
                                 model_col = "model",
                                 plot_title = "",
                                 x_label = "Estimate",
                                 save_path = NULL,
                                 plot_height = 10,
                                 plot_width = 15,
                                 multiply_estimate = FALSE) {
  
  forest_data <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      estimate = if(multiply_estimate) 100 * estimate else estimate,
      ci_lower = estimate - 1.96 * if(multiply_estimate) 100 * std.error else std.error,
      ci_upper = estimate + 1.96 * if(multiply_estimate) 100 * std.error else std.error,
      p_value = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper), ~round(., 3))) %>%
    mutate(ci = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lower, ci_upper))
  
  forest_plot_df <- forest_data %>%
    select(Group = !!sym(model_col), Estimate = estimate, 
           low = ci_lower, high = ci_upper, CI = ci, `P Value` = p_value) %>%
    arrange(desc(Estimate))
  
  forest_plot_df$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", 15), collapse = " ")
    
  # Reorder columns
  forest_plot_df <- forest_plot_df %>%
    select(Group, Estimate, low, high, ` `, `CI`, `P Value`)
  
  # New row to add
  new_row <- data.frame(
    Group = "No CHIP",
    Estimate = 0,
    low = 0,
    high = 0,
    ` ` = "",
    CI = "Reference",
    `P Value` = ""
  )
  names(new_row) = names(forest_plot_df)
  
  # Add the new row to the dataframe
  forest_plot_df <- rbind(forest_plot_df, new_row)

  # Determine x-axis range and tick positions
  x_range <- range(c(forest_plot_df$low, forest_plot_df$high))
  x_ticks <- pretty(x_range, n = 5)
        
  # Create forest plot
  p <- forest(forest_plot_df[,c(1, 5:7)],
              est = forest_plot_df$Estimate,
              lower = forest_plot_df$low, 
              upper = forest_plot_df$high,
              sizes = 0.6,
              ci_column = 2,
              ref_line = 0,
              title = plot_title)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    if (!grepl("\\.svg$", save_path)) {
      save_path <- paste0(save_path, ".svg")
    }
    
    # Save as SVG
    svglite(save_path, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
    plot(p)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  return(p)
}
 

# Create the forest plot
epc_tidy_models = prepare_tidy_models(list(chip_vs_no_chip_model, high_chip_vs_no_chip_model, tet2_chip_vs_no_chip_model, high_tet2_chip_vs_no_chip_model, dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model, high_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model), list("CHIP", "High VAF CHIP", "TET2 CHIP", "High VAF TET2 CHIP", "DNMT3A CHIP", "High VAF DNMT3A CHIP"))
(circ_epc_plot = generate_forest_plot(epc_tidy_models, plot_title = "Circulating Endothelial Progenitor Cells"))
save_plot(circ_epc_plot, "figures/forest/circulating_epc", svg = TRUE, width = 6)
```

summary(dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model)

# High DNMT3A CHIP vs no CHIP.
diab_high_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_data = epc_with_covariates %>%
  filter(diabetes_status == 1) %>%
  filter((haschip == 1 & Gene == "DNMT3A" & High_VAF == 1) | haschip == 0)
diab_high_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model = glm(rink_KDR133 ~ haschip + age8 + sex.x + BMI + hypertension_medication + cholesterol_ratio + log_trig + smoke_status, data = high_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_data)

diab_tidy_models = prepare_tidy_models(list(diab_chip_vs_no_chip_model, diab_high_chip_vs_no_chip_model, diab_tet2_chip_vs_no_chip_model, diab_high_tet2_chip_vs_no_chip_model, diab_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model, diab_high_dnmt3a_chip_vs_no_chip_model), list("CHIP", "High VAF CHIP", "TET2 CHIP", "High VAF TET2 CHIP", "DNMT3A CHIP", "High VAF DNMT3A CHIP"))
generate_forest_plot(diab_tidy_models, plot_title = "Circulating Endothelial Progenitors in Diabetes")
